headline: Pilots done on all 6 repos (10 trials, all scored, parity held). Waiting on the last better-auth tasks before freezing dataset v1 and starting the main run (360 trials).

phases.name: Repository selection
phases.note: 41 repos surveyed; top 3 per language by distinct authors: pydantic-ai, fastmcp, logfire, better-auth, zod, inngest-js

phases.name: Images, offline caches, test runners
phases.note: all 6 repos install and run tests offline; shared caches ~18 GB

phases.name: Execution validation (fail→pass, 3×)
phases.note: Python repos well along; zod and inngest-js started; better-auth after (disk)

phases.name: Instructions + independent test audit
phases.note: claude-opus-5-5, fresh context per task; auditor sees the instruction, tests, reference and repo

phases.name: Pilot (harness end to end)
phases.note: 5 pilot-window tasks, 10 trials; 13 harness fixes logged (CHANGELOG P1–P13)

log: Docker, nested Claude Code and the auth path verified inside containers
Internal Docker network + allow-list proxy: agent can reach the Anthropic API only
Design pre-registered before any data
Allow-list proxy verified: API reachable, PyPI blocked from trial containers
Trial runner, parity fingerprint, Claude call wrapper (counts Forge reviewer cost), transcript parser written
Analysis code tested on synthetic data: planted +10 pp recovered, CI coverage 29/30
Forge 091c0d3 built from a pristine worktree; package sha256 pinned
Pilot P1: repo ships its own .claude/, so the parity pre-check now targets Forge-only markers
Pilot P2–P3: PATH inherited from the container; ~/.claude/forge.lock.json counted as Forge-owned
Pilot P4: Forge setup committed after apply, as its Getting started says
Pilot P5: empty final.diff bug (git ownership) fixed, scorer self-test added; pilot re-run from scratch
Forge is active in its arm: SessionStart, PreToolUse guard, lint feedback after edits, Stop blocks on failing tests
Pilot P7–P10: auth refresh race, disk exhaustion reclassified as infrastructure (5 wrongly rejected candidates restored), .gitignore'd .claude, multi-result cost aggregation
zod pilot: both arms failed one task on type-level errors; Forge's Stop check blocked 3 times, then handed over
Scorer self-test passes on Python and TypeScript pilot tasks
inngest-js pilot: both arms resolved; Forge gave 1 feedback and 1 block
Observation: Sonnet 5.5 edits files only through Bash (no Edit/Write calls) in every pilot trial, both arms
Usage-limit utilisation is flat (7-day window 15%); not a constraint
better-auth pilot: both arms resolved; Forge's Stop check hit database-backed tests (no DB in the container) and blocked 3 times, 34 min vs 17 min wall
Pre-registered (D16): sensitivity analysis without better-auth, and Stop blocks per repo
P13: uv's uv_cache.json timestamp made prep non-deterministic; excluded; determinism verified on 6 repos
